messages:
Maya: Heads-up: p95 jumped ~200ms on the dashboard for /v1/generate (prod-us-east) right after we flipped the routing policy to prefer dedicated pools. Screenshot: https://console.redwood/shot.png Any idea if this is a real regression or a percentile artifact?
rafael: Checking logs now — my hunch is sample-origin shift. Did the fallback/weight change? When we merge tdigests across routes we can get surprising pctl inversions.
Maya: We only changed routing weight from 0.1 -> 0.6 for dedicated at 2024-06-15T13:02. No infra deploy at that time. Query I ran: `select percentile(duration_ms,95) from requests where endpoint='/v1/generate' group by endpoint`
sam: That query returns a merged tdigest for the endpoint. If two pools have different distros the merged p95 can move even if both pools are unchanged. Console shows endpoint-level p95 by default which hides route-level breakdown.
lisa: UX ask: can we add provenance info? small badge like "dominant route: dedicated (62% samples)" and a toggle to view percentiles by route. Also a tooltip explaining merge semantics.
rafael: Agree. On the API side the contract is ambiguous — `GET /metrics?agg=percentile&by=endpoint` returns merged tdigest. We could add `by=endpoint,route` or a `merge_mode=weighted|max` param. Need to think about how this affects SLO alerts and quota accounting.
metrics-bot: metric-alert: p95 for /v1/generate in prod-us-east exceeded threshold at 2024-06-15T13:04:12Z.
sam: Important note: quotas and SLAs are per-route. Showing only endpoint p95 without attribution can mislead SLO owners and trigger noisy alerts during routing rollouts. Default UX should warn rather than change behavior.
Maya: Can we add a rollout advisory in the console: "Percentiles reflect merged sample origins; routing policy changes may shift percentiles without performance regressions" + link to docs PR? That would cut down on incident noise.
lisa: :thumbsup: I'll draft the tooltip and console advisory. Rafael/sam — can you agree on `merge_mode` names? I can ship a UI canary next deploy.
rafael: I'll prototype `merge_mode` values: `tdigest-merge`, `per-route-weighted`, `per-route-max`. And add an opt-in API flag `provenance=true` to return sample counts per route. Will write up the proposal.
sam: Assign owners: Maya for dashboard copy and rollout advisory, me for API test coverage (simulate weight shift + ensure alert logic), rafael for API impl. If everyone OK I'll open PRs today.
